stoppingRule: Run all 1,120 planned attempts: ten independent trials for each of eight native adapters and fourteen cases, in seeded randomized blocks. The completed variability pilot selected ten trials under the predeclared rule in docs/implementation/publication-plan.md; see results/diagnostics/variability-pilot/ANALYSIS.json. Failed and unavailable attempts count toward the declared total. Do not retry selectively, stop early for favorable results, append trials to improve an ordering, or pool pilot data. Publish uncertainty only with at least five successful independent trials and flag interval width above 25% of the median as imprecise.
